source_note: 原文与颜色来自父代理 Playwright 读取的社区 Wiki 普通呈现页。raw 是由 DOM computed 样式还原的 Wiki 样本，不是服务器实测字节；颜色和格式以 dialogues[].segments[].color 为准。全部 145 个 DOM 源行均逐行审计，空白、舞台说明及破损样本不写入正文。
note:
身份: 蘑菇沙漠的动物研究者、商店经营者，地下实验室的作物分析仪研发者；绿洲钓获生物和湖中皇帝可触发专属对白。
关系: 起初请玩家帮忙带动物；面对 Beth 质疑先掩饰，之后逐渐信任玩家与 Beth。
说话方式: 热情朴素，谈研究时认真；受惊时大声辩解，不把大写直接译成中二宣言。
性格与词汇: 动物、毛绒玩具、研究、样本；防备、谨慎又执着。页面内 Beth 的真实发言只在 context 标明，绝不冒充 Jake。
禁用风格: 不补实验机制，不改人物关系，不硬塞网络梗，不将品牌或人名汉化。
todo: source_line 42 含破损的 &&<capitalized player name>，整行暂不建立匹配；需要可靠呈现页或游戏内完整样本，不猜修原文或颜色。

messages.context: 真实 speaker: Jake；Jake 的屋子，首次交谈
messages.text: Hi I'm Jake. I've been living on this island for 25 years.
messages.raw: §fHi I'm Jake. I've been living on this island for 25 years.
messages.gloss: 25 年是角色背景中的固定时长，不是实时年份。
messages.zh: 你好，我是 Jake。我在这座岛上已经住了 25 年。

messages.context: 真实 speaker: Jake；Jake 的屋子，首次交谈
messages.text: I used to study animals from all over the land!
messages.raw: §fI used to study animals from all over the land!
messages.zh: 以前我研究过各地的动物!

messages.context: 真实 speaker: Jake；Jake 的屋子，首次交谈
messages.text: Unfortunately, I suffered an injury which restricts me from leaving my house.
messages.raw: §fUnfortunately, I suffered an injury which restricts me from leaving my house.
messages.gloss: 角色此时声称受伤无法出门；不替后续剧情纠正这句说辞。
messages.zh: 可惜后来受了伤，现在没法出门了。

messages.context: 真实 speaker: Jake；Jake 的屋子，首次交谈
messages.text: I really enjoyed studying animals.
messages.raw: §fI really enjoyed studying animals.
messages.zh: 我是真的很喜欢研究动物。

messages.text: Could you bring me an animal? You can find them all over the island!
messages.raw: §fCould you bring me an animal? You can find them all over the island!

messages.zh: 能帮我带只动物来吗? 岛上到处都能找到!

messages.context: 真实 speaker: Jake；其他玩家带来动物，或商店开放时再次带来相同动物
messages.text: I'm feeling generous, I'll show you my store.
messages.raw: §fI'm feeling generous, I'll show you my store.

messages.raw: §fSomeone already brought me this animal recently, but since you put in all the effort I'll open my store for you.

messages.raw: §fPlease tell me the truth this time Jake, I can't take all these lies anymore!
messages.zh: Jake，这次请告诉我实话，我再也受不了这些谎话了!

messages.text: It's... it's not what it looks like. This lab... it's for research. To improve farming techniques, to help both crops and animals adapt to new environments.

messages.zh: 不……不是你想的那样。这间实验室……是用来做研究的。我想改进农业技术，帮助作物和动物适应新的环境。

segments.text: It's... it's not what it looks like. This lab... it's for research. To improve farming techniques, to help both

messages.context: 真实 speaker: Jake；Beth 再次进入地下实验室，解释研究动机
messages.text: You don't understand, Beth! Farming as we know is evolving. If we don't adapt, we'll be left behind. The world's demands are growing, and so are the challenges.

messages.context: 真实 speaker: Beth；Beth 再次进入地下实验室；未命中现有 Beth CHAT 记录
messages.text: That doesn't give you the right to hide this from everyone. What about the risks? The ethics?
messages.raw: §fThat doesn't give you the right to hide this from everyone. What about the risks? The ethics?
messages.zh: 那也不代表你有权瞒着所有人。风险呢? 伦理呢?

messages.context: 真实 speaker: Beth；Beth 再次进入地下实验室；未命中现有 Beth CHAT 记录
